Accepted.description: Result of a control call: the hub took it (True) or refused it.
Accepted.title: Accepted

Activity.description: One activity from the hub's catalog.
Activity.title: Activity

ActivityChanged.description: The running activity changed (None = powered off / idle).
ActivityChanged.title: ActivityChanged

Button.description:
A remote button bound on an activity or device.

``button_code`` is what you send to that entity; ``device_id`` /
``command_id`` are the underlying target it maps to, None for an
unbound slot. ``name`` is the ``ButtonName`` alias when the code has
one.
Button.title: Button

CatalogReady.description: The connect-time initial sync completed (True) or the session dropped (False).
CatalogReady.title: CatalogReady

Command.description: A device command; send with ``send(device_id, command_id)``.
Command.title: Command

ConnectionState.description: A hub-side (``hub_state``) or app-side (``app_state``) link came up or went down.
ConnectionState.title: ConnectionState

Device.description:
One device from the hub's catalog.

``power_state`` is the hub's live power byte for the device (0 off,
1 on) as of the last devices fetch; None when the row carried no
parseable record. The hub commits it with a macro-runtime lag after a
power fire, so it is not an instantaneous read. ``idle_behavior`` is
the device's power-behaviour mode when known.
Device.title: Device

Favorite.description: An activity favorite: a device command; send with ``send(device_id, command_id)``.
Favorite.title: Favorite

HubConfig.description:
Everything needed to proxy one hub, as data.

Fields beyond ``host`` refine the proxy's mDNS identity (``name``,
``txt``, ``hub_version``) or its two network faces (``port`` on the
hub, ``hub_listen_port`` and ``app_discovery_port`` on this host).
``is_proxy`` is True when the record was built from one of *our own*
proxy advertisements rather than a physical hub; a consumer
registering hubs from a foreign discovery feed uses it to map such a
record back to the hub it already fronts instead of proxying a proxy.
HubConfig.title: HubConfig

HubCreate.description: Body of ``POST /hubs``: the ``HubConfig`` fields, host required.
HubCreate.title: HubCreate

HubInfo.description:
Identity of the physical hub, as read from its connect banner.

``known`` is False until the banner has been read at least once; the
other fields are then None.
HubInfo.title: HubInfo

HubStatus.description: Live connection state of one proxied hub. Pure state read, no hub traffic.
HubStatus.title: HubStatus

HubStatusView.description: ``GET /hubs/{id}/status``: the server's enabled flag beside the library status.
HubStatusView.title: HubStatusView

HubView.description: What ``/hubs`` returns per hub: the record plus a status snapshot.
HubView.title: HubView

Macro.description: An activity macro; send with ``send(activity_id, command_id)``.
Macro.title: Macro

Problem.description: Error body (RFC 9457 shape, minus the URI scheme).
Problem.title: Problem

RunningActivity.description: The activity currently running on the hub.
RunningActivity.title: RunningActivity

SeenHub.description: A physical hub advertised on the LAN (not yet necessarily configured).
SeenHub.title: SeenHub

command_id.description: command id, macro id, or button code
command_id.title: Command Id

ServerInfo.description: What ``GET /api/v1/server`` returns (and what the mDNS TXT says, in full).
ServerInfo.title: ServerInfo

StatusChanged.description: The proxy's mode flipped (derived from hub and app connection state).
StatusChanged.title: StatusChanged

info.description:
REST + WebSocket over the sofabaton-x library for Sofabaton X1 / X1S / X2 hubs. LAN service; no authentication in v1.

WebSocket: `/api/v1/events` (optional `?hub_id=` filter, repeatable) streams WsHello once, then WsHubEvent / WsServerEvent / WsDropped messages (see components).
info.title: sofabaton-x-server
